proposedContributions.change: Implement an isolated headless Tiptap/ProseMirror-to-Loro adapter using the existing rich schema/extensions rather than Markdown as the live authority. Export candidate-neutral typed probe inputs/results and ProbeEditorRoundTrip, ProbeSelectiveUndo, ProbeCursor; include frontier, schemaVersion, logical document tree/marks/entity refs and anchor state in results. Apply incremental local transactions to Loro and remote changes to the editor with origin tagging so echoes do not append duplicate updates. Delegate selective undo to the canonical CRDT undo mechanism and disable competing editor history only in collaborative mode. Persist/export/import versioned fixture snapshots plus operation tail; resolve anchors against CRDT positions, never DOM offsets.

Implement the same probe contract independently with React Lexical-compatible headless editor nodes and the same Loro authority; reuse only candidate-neutral types from the Tiptap spike via type-only import, not Tiptap binding behavior. Map nested lists/task items, marks, stable entity-ref nodes and selection anchors to the same canonical fixture schema. Produce explicit unsupported-schema/binding failures, not Markdown flattening or a fake passing fallback.

Own one shared generated fixture matrix and deterministic seed 20260979; run each identical case against both probe implementations. Cover rich-text/list/entity-node round-trip; independent peers concurrent at one position; reordered/duplicate updates; offline snapshot+tail restart; actor-local undo/redo preserving remote insert; anchor movement/deleted-target orphan and cursor expiry. Add authenticated operator, idempotency/crash/reply and denied-actor scenarios only through accepted lead gateway interfaces. Keep caught mutation controls separate from infrastructure errors and include independently injected holdout.

Record tested implementation revision, dependency versions/license hashes, fixture schema and seed, both candidate outcome matrices, reproduction traces/artifact hashes, and a transparent migration-cost comparison. Eligible candidates must pass every required oracle. Compare concrete existing caller/API changes, preserved rich-node/export fidelity, authority/schema work and replacement surface cost, with rationale rather than an ungrounded time estimate. Select one adapter only after observed proof; if Tiptap fails and Lexical passes select React Lexical document subtype with the same canonical ref. If neither passes record blocked and no selected passing adapter.

risks: Loro/Tiptap binding, selective undo and rich entity-node fidelity are unproven. A binding that converges text but loses list/marks/refs/anchors is failing, not partly complete.
StarterKit local history plus CRDT undo or Yjs plus Loro authority can erase remote changes or create competing document truth; disable only the competing mechanism in explicit collaborative mode.
The focused-editor content guard skips incoming Markdown changes; naïvely piping remote snapshots through current controlled content props fails focused concurrent editing and anchors.
WikiLink/HashTag are decorations over raw text, not stable typed entity nodes; substituting them for the required entity-node fixture weakens the acceptance oracle.
PageKind is sandbox runtime capability; inserting a lexical/tiptap kind there conflates document subtype and HTML permissions. A document cannot be made available by merely setting contentDigest.

Wave0 DocumentDescriptor and Markdown commit reconciliation already provide identity/authority mechanisms. New editor stores, global Notes replacement or whole-Markdown CRDT writes would undermine them.

Refreshed NotesPage now also binds committed block trees, stable #^ block navigation and marker-mapping previews to sourceStoreId/revision/sourceHash/authorityEpoch. Candidate migration cost and shared patches must preserve these existing mechanisms; they are not proof of CRDT-position anchors.

Published full-feature DoD demands mechanisms owned by WP-04/05/06/07/09/51 despite only WP-02/03 explicit dependencies. Preserve explicit array and expose capability gaps for lead resolution, not silent N/A or speculative new stores.

WP-10 consumes WP-49 and WP-15 consumes WP-10. Requiring their production Page/WAL/history implementations before candidate probes introduces a cycle; isolated probe evidence and live integration evidence must remain distinct.
No passing candidate means blocked, not an automatic Lexical success. Migration cost is compared only among passing, license-accepted candidates.
Current Page RPC source passes caller workspaceId and mostly ignores _ctx; native annotation helpers and digest-bound action grants do not prove shared principal/resource ACL.
Separate HTML/config writes and full list push cannot meet durable result/outbox/restart requirements; replay must be reconciled using the accepted command authority.
Whole-file hashes reflect inspected uncommitted working tree and may change during root integration; stale evidence must be reread before implementation or acceptance.
No build/test/UI/network verification ran in this preflight by instruction. Report validation is not a feature completion or runtime pass.
